name: specx
description: A structured spec-driven workflow for lightweight coding models, with explicit stages, task-size routing, traceable artifacts, independent verification, bounded repair loops, and archive history.

interface.shortDescription: Structured, stage-gated spec workflows for lightweight coding models.
interface.longDescription: Specx preserves the original structured workflow for models that benefit from explicit stage boundaries and detailed execution contracts. It selects a bundle, routes by task size, clarifies behavior, plans against existing code, executes with traceable tasks, independently verifies results in bounded loops, and archives completed work.
defaultPrompt: Use specx-flow only for non-trivial coding development work, not docs-only or skill/prompt edits.
After specx-flow routes, load the required next stage skill before doing stage work.
Use specx-flow to resume an active Specx bundle and select the required stage.
